description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, a DbContext implementation for Entity Framework Core, managing database sets and relationships for the Conduit application, including transaction handling.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: A DbContext class for managing database entities and relationships in the Conduit application.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with rollback on failure.
